action_items: (Optional, carried over) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' on app/index.tsx and theme shadows().

(Optional) StudySet response model does not include is_saved field (see Pydantic model), so preview modal relies on freshly-fetched doc; works today but consider adding is_saved to StudySet Pydantic model for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: StudySet Pydantic model in server.py lacks an 'is_saved' field but is_saved is written to Mongo by POST /save and read via the filter. The list endpoint returns via StudySet(**d) which silently drops is_saved. The frontend reads is_saved from StudySet responses — currently works because extra fields pass through UI but is fragile; add 'is_saved: bool = False' to StudySet.
toggle_save endpoint does not return 200 body including the full StudySet — only {id,is_saved}, which is fine for the current UI contract.
